_what: M0c Session A pre-registration -- head separability. Written before anything is fit.
written_before: any M0c checkpoint, any trained set-wise or listwise scorer, any M0c R@1 number, and any M0c point on the precision/coverage curve

scope_boundary._why: another session is running M2 in parallel on the loop, tools and permissions

split.rule: unchanged and never re-drawn; sha256-stratified even/odd per category
split._heldout_discipline: the held-out split is read ONCE, at the end, on the arm selected by the rule in `selection_rule`. Every selection read below is fit-split or fit-carved-validation.

adr_016_gate_resolution.consequence: the isotonic gate has no vocabulary for confident subsets and a perfect retrieval system scores 0.8483 on it. This session does NOT refit the gate and does NOT touch THRESHOLD = 0.95. Every curve here is measured at query resolution.

adr_015_int8_is_shape_bound.consequence: any new graph is f32. No quantization is attempted, and no invariance is inherited from the shipped graph.

adr_017_estimator_rule.rule: a correction term must be fitted against RELEVANCE, not against the score
adr_017_estimator_rule.consequence: every arm below is trained against a gold label, never against the incumbent's own score distribution. No arm distils the shipped logits.

reach_checks_run_before_this_file_was_wr._why: ADR-010, ADR-013 and ADR-014, in that order. All three were run offline, on the fit split, before any arm was designed. Their artifacts are in runs/session-m0c/.

R0_attainability_of_the_criterion_itself.finding: K1's interval reading is UNATTAINABLE at 10% coverage on n=229 for ANY mechanism. A perfect selector -- 23 of 23 -- has a Clopper-Pearson 95% lower bound of 0.8518, and 0.8518 < 0.95.
R0_attainability_of_the_criterion_itself.consequence_binding_on_this_session: no band is registered on 'reaches 0.95 by interval at 10% coverage'. That is a quantity the split cannot express, and registering a band on it would be ADR-010's error committed against the criterion instead of against a shape. The bands below are on the POINT ESTIMATE at declared coverages, on R@1, and on the coverage at which the interval CAN clear.
R0_attainability_of_the_criterion_itself._this_is_a_finding_not_a_caveat: it retires a target the project would otherwise have spent sessions chasing, in the same way ADR-016 retired the 0.3739 ceiling.

can_move.precision at the operating point: YES. The selector chooses which 23 of 229 queries are injected; 173 fit queries are correct, so 0..23 of 23 is reachable. Incumbent margin selects 21/23.

cannot_move.R@1, R@5, R@10, input recall: NO, STRUCTURALLY. A selector reorders nothing inside a slate. Registering an R@1 band on candidate A would repeat Session D's error verbatim.

R1_candidate_A_confidence_signal.measured_screen_on_fit: no single query-time feature beats the margin at 10% coverage. Best AUC is margin_1_3 at 0.7137 against the margin's 0.6677, and it scores WORSE at the head (20/23 vs 21/23). Overall discrimination and head discrimination are different quantities on this corpus.
R1_candidate_A_confidence_signal.verdict: candidate A is registered as a SECONDARY arm with its own band. It is not expected to carry the session and the screen is the reason, recorded before the fit.

can_move.R@1, R@5, conditional accuracy, and ever: YES. A joint scorer reorders the slate.

cannot_move.input recall / gold-in-slate: NO. The slate is an INPUT. Hard ceiling 0.9214 fit, 0.9039 held-out.

measured_headroom.gap_le_1_0_logits: 46 of 53 (87%), worth +0.2009 R@1 if all flipped

joint_structure_hypothesis.measured: among failures the gold is same-session as the wrong rank 1 in 52.8% of held-out cases, against 40.3% for the rank1/rank2 relation among successes. Enrichment is 1.3x on held-out and 1.8x on fit.
joint_structure_hypothesis.reading_registered_now: WEAK support. Real but small. This is registered before the fit so a strong result is not later attributed to a relation the data only weakly shows, and so a null is not read as surprising.
joint_structure_hypothesis.a_defect_caught_and_recorded: the first version of this read compared rank 1 to the gold in BOTH groups. On successes the gold IS rank 1, so 'same session' was 1.0000 by construction -- a null instrument. The contrast was changed to rank1-vs-rank2 on the success side before any number was believed.

training_free_proxies_measured_and_both_.slate_z_score: 0 discordant. A within-slate monotone transform cannot change argmax -- ADR-015 arm 6's identity, re-confirmed.
training_free_proxies_measured_and_both_.hand_rule_promote_the_user_turn_rank1_an: 5 discordant, 0 gained, 5 LOST. The naive relational rule is wrong-signed.
training_free_proxies_measured_and_both_.consequence: no training-free proxy is a valid instrument check for a trained arm. Per ADR-014 the discordance is measured on the ARM ITSELF, on fit, on the exact contrast, before the held-out read. That measurement is a precondition of the held-out read and is listed in `preconditions_of_the_heldout_read`.

arms._all_trained_on_fit_only: training data is drawn from fit-split queries only. Model selection uses a validation slice carved from fit BY CONVERSATION ID, not by query id, reusing Session J's leakage rule.
arms._all_f32: ADR-015. No quantization anywhere in this session.

L1_listwise_objective_same_inference_sha.what: fine-tune the pair cross-encoder with a LISTWISE softmax cross-entropy over the depth-10 slate, instead of Session J's pairwise MarginMSE.
L1_listwise_objective_same_inference_sha.inference: IDENTICAL to shipped -- 10 independent pair passes at seq 256, batch 1. No latency change, no architecture change, no new tensor shape.
L1_listwise_objective_same_inference_sha.why_it_is_not_closed: the closed list names length normalization, reranker CAPACITY, fusion, consolidation, PRF, entity expansion, HyDE, session pruning and raising MAX_SEQ_LEN. A change of TRAINING OBJECTIVE at fixed capacity, fixed sequence length and fixed inference shape is none of those.
L1_listwise_objective_same_inference_sha.why_it_is_not_candidate_B: it is trained listwise but SCORES independently. It is registered as the control that separates 'the objective was wrong' from 'independent scoring is the limit'. Without it, a win from S1/S2 could not be attributed to joint observation.

L2_listwise_with_mined_slate_augmentatio.what: L1, plus synthetic slates assembled from Session J's 6,898 mined hard negatives (temporal_adjacency, entity_overlap, opposite_role, long_assistant).
L2_listwise_with_mined_slate_augmentatio.why: 229 real fit slates is a small listwise corpus. The mined negatives are already fit-only and already conversation-split.

S1_setwise_head_over_pair_representation.what: the frozen shipped pair encoder produces a per-candidate representation; a small permutation-equivariant transformer attends ACROSS the ten candidates and emits a re-score.
S1_setwise_head_over_pair_representation.why_it_is_candidate_B: the head observes the slate jointly. It can express 'B supersedes A' at the representation level.
S1_setwise_head_over_pair_representation.inference: the ten existing pair passes, unchanged, plus one head pass over ten vectors. Expected marginal cost is sub-millisecond and it is MEASURED, not assumed.
S1_setwise_head_over_pair_representation.permutation_equivariance: no positional encoding over the candidate axis. Registered as a property to VERIFY, not assume: the head's output must be invariant to input permutation to 0.000000, measured on the fit slates.

S2_global_cross_encoder_over_the_top_k.what: [CLS] Q [SEP] T_1 [SEP] ... [SEP] T_k over the top k of the shipped ranking, k = 4, allowing token-level cross-talk between candidates.
S2_global_cross_encoder_over_the_top_k.why_k_is_4: 89% of held-out recoverable gold sits at rank <= 4 (47 of 53). k is fixed at 4 BEFORE the fit and is not swept -- ADR-013's second lesson: a registration that leaves a free hyperparameter has not fixed the experiment.
S2_global_cross_encoder_over_the_top_k.sequence_length: 512, on a NEW graph. This is not 'raising MAX_SEQ_LEN' on the shipped pair encoder -- that is the closed item, and the shipped pair encoder stays at 256. A global scorer over four concatenated candidates cannot exist at 256 and its length is a property of the shape, not a tuning knob.
S2_global_cross_encoder_over_the_top_k.cost_risk_registered_in_advance: one 512-token pass on a 2-layer model, added to the existing 214 ms/query. The cold budget margin is 62 ms. If measured latency breaks 300 ms P95 this arm is UNSHIPPABLE regardless of quality, and that is recorded now so a winning arm is not discovered to be unshippable afterwards -- Session J's registered lesson.

C1_relevance_fitted_confidence_selector.what: candidate A. A logistic model predicting CORRECTNESS (not score) from query-time slate features, used only to select which queries are injected.
C1_relevance_fitted_confidence_selector.features: the screened set in reach-r1-confidence.json. `category` is EXCLUDED -- LongMemEval's question_type is a label, not a runtime signal, and a selector reading it would be scoring with the answer sheet.
C1_relevance_fitted_confidence_selector.adr_017_compliance: the target is the binary gold-hit label. No feature is fitted against the rerank score.
C1_relevance_fitted_confidence_selector.band_is_separate: C1 is judged on precision at matched coverage ONLY. It cannot move R@1 and no R@1 band is registered on it.

selection_rule._why_declared_now: so the winner cannot be chosen with the held-out result in view.
selection_rule.primary: the ranking arm (L1, L2, S1, S2) with the highest R@1 on the FIT-CARVED VALIDATION SLICE. Ties within 0.005 are broken by measured added latency, lowest wins; ties within 0.005 AND within 5 ms are broken by simplicity of inference shape, in the order L1 > L2 > S1 > S2.
selection_rule.combination: the selected ranking arm is then combined with C1 as a selector, and the combination is read on held-out ALONGSIDE the ranking arm alone. Both are reported; the ranking arm alone is the headline.
selection_rule.how_many_heldout_reads: ONE pass over the held-out split, producing all reported held-out numbers at once.

number_1_heldout_r_at_1.name: the headline
number_1_heldout_r_at_1.definition: top-1 gold-hit rate on the 229 eligible held-out queries, read by the ranking functions in tools/analyze_cue_overlap.py, unmodified.

floor._rule: shipped baseline + 0.02. An arm below this FAILS OUTRIGHT and does not ship. No partial credit and no re-tuning.
floor._why_0_02: Session J's fine-tune moved +0.0699 with a pairwise objective and the McNemar power to detect it. An objective and architecture change that cannot clear a third of that has not earned a place on the scored path.

number_1_heldout_r_at_1._derivation_of_the_prediction: 53 recoverable held-out failures; 87% sit within 1.0 logits of the wrong rank 1 and 60% at rank 2. Recovering a third of them is +0.077. The upper end assumes 57% recovery, which is what the stated 0.80 goal requires.
number_1_heldout_r_at_1._stretch_is_not_a_band: 0.80 is the human's stated goal. It is recorded so the session is honest about what it was aiming at, and it is NOT a pass/fail condition -- a band chosen to match an aspiration is not a band.

number_2_precision_at_the_head.name: the operating point, point estimate
number_2_precision_at_the_head.definition: precision among the top 10% of held-out queries by the arm's own confidence key, with a Clopper-Pearson 95% interval.

floor._rule: 20 of 23. The head must not LOSE more than one case. K1 condition 3 forbids buying coverage with precision; the symmetric care is that a ranking gain must not be bought with head precision.
floor._why_not_a_gain_floor: R0 shows the head has two cases of headroom on n=23 and no interval reading can clear 0.95 there. Requiring a gain on a 23-case read would be a band narrower than the instrument's resolution -- ADR-012.

number_2_precision_at_the_head._no_interval_band: per R0. Reported always, never used as a pass condition at this coverage.

number_3_the_coverage_at_which_the_inter.name: the honest K1 read
number_3_the_coverage_at_which_the_inter.definition: the lowest coverage level whose Clopper-Pearson 95% lower bound reaches 0.95, or the statement that none does.
number_3_the_coverage_at_which_the_inter.baseline: none. No coverage level clears on the shipped configuration.
number_3_the_coverage_at_which_the_inter.floor: none registered -- this is a report, not a test.
number_3_the_coverage_at_which_the_inter.predicted: none clears. R0 requires 72 consecutive correct injections at zero errors; the shipped head errs at 2 of 23.
number_3_the_coverage_at_which_the_inter._why_registered_anyway: so the K1 answer is computed and stated rather than inferred, and so a surprising pass is not discovered informally.

number_4_flatness_kill_condition.definition: unchanged from ADR-019: flat iff NOT (precision@10 > precision@100 AND ci_low@10 > precision@100).
number_4_flatness_kill_condition.predicted: NOT flat, as in Session K.
number_4_flatness_kill_condition._binding: if a candidate arm produces a FLAT curve it fails K1's kill condition and does not ship regardless of its R@1.

number_5_C1_at_matched_coverage.definition: precision at 10% coverage using C1's key instead of the rerank margin, on the SAME ranking.
number_5_C1_at_matched_coverage.floor: none. C1 is exploratory and R1 already predicts it will not beat the margin.
number_5_C1_at_matched_coverage._prediction_registered_because_R1_is_neg: R1's fit screen found no feature beating the margin at the head. If C1 beats it on held-out, that is a fit/held-out disagreement and must be reported as one, not as a win.

budget.condition: retrieval P95 <= 300 ms cache-cold on the bounded 40-case subset, AND no case above 7,000 retrieval tokens
budget.if_violated: the precision numbers are VOID, not caveated. K1 is defined at those budgets. An arm that violates it is UNSHIPPABLE regardless of quality.
budget._margin_is_thin: the shipped configuration measures 238 ms cold. 62 ms of headroom.

determinism.condition: `repro --runs 2` WITHOUT an embedding cache is byte-identical, run EARLY
determinism.if_violated: no quality number is read at all

per_graph_invariance.condition: any NEW graph re-measures discrimination, determinism, batch invariance and padding invariance FROM SCRATCH. Nothing is inherited from the shipped graph.
per_graph_invariance._adr_013: determinism is re-verified per graph, never inherited

second_implementation.condition: the Rust implementation of any adopted scorer must reproduce the Python offline read EXACTLY, as 0.5764 = 0.5764 in Session H and 0.6725 = 0.6725 in Session K

eval_unchanged.condition: `cd eval && python -m pytest` prints 72 and eval/ has no diff
eval_unchanged._why: eval/ is the scoreboard. It is read-only this session by instruction.

conformance_before_any_quality_number.expected_outcome: REJECTED, 0 findings, fail_no_time_dependence -- the unchanged baseline since Session B. This is EXPECTED and is not evidence about this session's arms.

preconditions_of_the_heldout_read._why: ADR-014's binding rule. These are measured on FIT, on the selected arm, and written down BEFORE the held-out split is touched.
preconditions_of_the_heldout_read.1_adr_010_reach_on_the_built_arm: the selected arm must CHANGE top-1 on at least 10 fit queries against the shipped ranking. An arm that reorders nothing cannot move R@1 and its delta is an identity.
preconditions_of_the_heldout_read.2_adr_013_both_directions: movement in both directions -- gained > 0 AND lost > 0 -- or the arm is reported as dominating rather than as tested.

3_adr_014_power.test: two-sided exact McNemar over queries whose top-1 differs
3_adr_014_power.why: exact McNemar's smallest attainable two-sided p is 2/2^n; 2/2^6 = 0.03125 <= 0.05
3_adr_014_power.contrast_the_test_consumes: selected arm's top-1 vs SHIPPED top-1, same slate, same split, same population of 229
3_adr_014_power.if_below_the_floor: alpha is declared UNATTAINABLE IN ADVANCE, no p-value is reported, and the delta carries the verdict alone and is labelled as such
3_adr_014_power._6_is_a_floor_not_a_target: the fit-measured n is reported beside every p so a reader can see what the test could have detected

4_the_selector_contrast_is_a_different_t.test: Fisher's exact, two-sided, on the 2x2 of (arm-only vs margin-only) x (correct vs wrong) over the swap set at matched coverage
4_the_selector_contrast_is_a_different_t.why_not_mcnemar: the two selectors inject DIFFERENT queries, so there are no paired per-query outcomes
4_the_selector_contrast_is_a_different_t.formula: smallest attainable two-sided p is 2 / C(2m, m); 2/C(8,4) = 0.0286

calibration_generalization._standing_check: fit-split prediction vs held-out measurement, stated per arm before the read
calibration_generalization.the_specific_hazard_this_session: the shipped reranker was FINE-TUNED on fit-split conversations, so fit R@1 is 0.7555 against held-out 0.6725 -- a 0.0830 optimism gap on the BASELINE itself. Every arm trained on fit inherits that gap and will look better on fit than it is. The fit-carved validation slice is split by conversation to bound it, and the predicted held-out delta is registered BELOW the fit-validation delta by construction.
calibration_generalization.registered_prediction: each arm's held-out delta will be SMALLER than its fit-validation delta. If any arm's held-out delta EXCEEDS its fit delta, that is not a bonus -- it is evidence the validation slice is not measuring what it claims and must be reported as such.

out_of_scope_and_not_attempted: session pruning as a quality mechanism
raising MAX_SEQ_LEN on the shipped PAIR encoder (ADR-015); S2's 512 is a new graph of a different shape, argued separately above
reranker capacity -- every arm initialises from an L-2 model; no larger backbone is adopted
re-tuning the gate's calibration resolution (ADR-016 forbids it explicitly)
modifying eval/ -- it is the scoreboard and it prints 72
turn-pair chunking -- named as open in STATE.md and deliberately deferred; it changes INGEST and this session is scoped to the scored path
standing_checks: repro --runs 2 WITHOUT a cache, run EARLY
cargo test --workspace and cd eval && pytest at 72
a second implementation of a scored-path component must reproduce the first EXACTLY
determinism, batch and padding invariance re-measured PER GRAPH, never inherited
ONNX graph optimization level pinned on both sides: ORT_ENABLE_BASIC / Level1
every adopted model pinned by sha256
the artifact the driver reads must be the artifact the run scored with
analyze_cue_overlap.py is the authority for binary-side R@1 and publish_precision_coverage.py refuses to write unless it matches

the_named_next_lever_if_every_arm_fails._why_named_now: so the response to a failure cannot be chosen with the failure in view
the_named_next_lever_if_every_arm_fails.next: turn-pair chunking at ingest. It is the cheapest untested structural idea, it addresses fragment boundaries directly, and it is the only named open item that moves INPUT RECALL -- the 0.9039 ceiling every arm in this session is bounded by. If joint scoring cannot recover the 53, the constraint moves upstream of the reranker.
